name: @wowlua/web
description: wowlua in a web page: the compiler, checker, formatter and language server for World of Warcraft addons, as WebAssembly

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p wowlua-web && wasm-bindgen --target web --no-typescript --out-dir pkg ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wowlua_web.wasm
